title: A zoom callout fills the space between its two lines with a faint tint of the line colour
goal: The two lines that join a zoom callout's source box to its magnified box enclose a band of space. Fill that band with the line colour at 10% opacity by default, so the callout reads as one beam from the source to the magnifier; the fill's opacity is adjustable (and can be set to 0 to turn it off).
notes:
User's words (2026-10-13): "the zoom lens has lines connecting the closest edge of the target to the closest edge of the zoom. I'd like the area in between to be filled the line color but be 10% opacity (configurable)." ('zoom lens' here is the zoom callout: source box, magnified box, two leader lines.)

From code reading (not run): leader lines come from PhotonzCore Geometry.leaderLines(source:callout:) and the turned variant (Geometry.swift:334-360, nearest corners); drawn by PhotonzRender/ZoomCalloutOverlayRasterizer.swift (:66) and previewed in Sources/Photonz/CanvasAnnotationPreview.swift (:392). ZoomCalloutContent (PhotonzCore/Layer.swift:752) has sourceRect, magnification, shape; add a fill opacity (Codable default). The band polygon is the two leader segments' endpoints in order; for circles use the external tangents.
acceptance: The band is the area bounded by the two leader lines and the facing sides of the source box and the magnified box (for a circle callout, the area between the two tangent lines), drawn UNDER both boxes so it never tints the magnified picture or the source area
Its colour is the callout's line colour at a new Fill opacity, default 10%, shown in the callout's appearance controls as a slider (0 to 100%) next to the line colour; 0 hides it

It follows the callout live while moving or resizing either box, rotating the callout, and changing its shape (rectangle or circle), with no gaps at the corners (the band's edges sit exactly on the leader lines, MEASURED within 1 px)
Export, copy and the canvas match; old callouts open with the band at the default 10% (or, if the audit argues old documents should not change, at 0 with new callouts at 10%, stated in the audit)
The Callout style in the Library carries the fill opacity for new callouts
A walk makes a callout, checks a pixel inside the band is the line colour blended at about 10%, sets Fill opacity to 0 and checks the band is gone, and photographs both
Audit under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.
